headlines.title: GE Vernova Stock And 2 Nuclear Power Shares In The Spotlight
headlines.summary: The Elementl Power deal has turned a niche corner of U.S. nuclear power into front-page capital markets news, with up to $750 million of potential funding suddenly in play. That kind of early money can shift expectations fast, especially for businesses tied to small modular reactors and construction partners like Samsung C&T. This piece walks through three stocks from the screener that appear most exposed to this story and explains how that exposure could help or hurt investors over time.

headlines.title: General Electric (GE) Picks Rahul Vaidyanathan For India Communications As Aerospace Focus Grows
headlines.summary: General Electric (NYSE:GE) unit GE Aerospace has appointed Rahul Vaidyanathan as Communication Director, India. The role focuses on India’s aerospace and aviation sector at a time of rapid expansion in the domestic ecosystem. GE Aerospace is aiming to reinforce its messaging and public profile in India across supply chain, engineering, and manufacturing activities.

headlines.title: Gas Turbine Technology Patent Landscape and Market Intelligence Report, 2010-2024 | $34.75 Billion Market by 2032 Spurs Low-Emission and Manufacturing Innovation
headlines.summary: More than 13,000 gas-turbine patents were filed between 2010 and 2024, 80% of them since 2015, as innovation shifts toward low-emission combustion, advanced materials and 3D-printed parts, a new Research and Markets report finds. The equipment market is projected to grow from about $24 billion in 2024 to nearly $35 billion by 2032, with General Electric, Siemens and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries among the top players.Dublin, Oct.

description: General Electric Company, doing business as GE Aerospace, designs and produces commercial and defense aircraft engines, integrated engine components, electric power, and aircraft systems. The company operates through two segments, Commercial Engines & Services, and Defense & Propulsion Technologies. The Commercial Engines & Services segment designs, develops, manufactures, maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services of jet engines and sale of spare parts for commercial airframes, business aviation, and aeroderivative applications. The Defense & Propulsion Technologies designs, develops, manufactures, and services jet engines and avionics and power systems for governments, militaries, and commercial airframers, as well as MRO of engines and the sale of spare parts. This segment also offers aircraft components and systems, such as small turboprop engines, aeroengine mechanical transmissions, turbines, combustors and controls, additive manufacturing, propeller systems, ignition systems, sensors and engine accessories for fixed wing and rotorcraft applications for commercial and military end users under the Avio Aero, Unison, Dowty Propellers, and Colibrium Additive brands. The company operates in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Americas, the Middle East, and Africa. General Electric Company was incorporated in 1892 and is based in Evendale, Ohio.
